info:
SunnyBrew Cafe & Bakery - Business Guide & FAQs

General Information:
- Location: 142 Maplewood Avenue, Downtown
- Phone: (555) 382-7740
- Email: hello@sunnybrewcafe.com
- Wi-Fi: Free high-speed guest Wi-Fi available for all paying customers (Network: SunnyBrew-Guest, Password on receipt).
- Seating & Atmosphere: Indoor seating for 35 guests, outdoor dog-friendly patio with heated lamps during colder months.

Operating Hours:
- Monday to Friday: 6:30 AM - 6:00 PM
- Saturday: 7:30 AM - 7:00 PM
- Sunday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM
- Holidays: Closed on Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Open 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM on New Year's Day.

Menu Highlights & Pricing:
- Coffee & Espresso:
  - Drip Coffee (House Blend / Dark Roast): Small $3.00, Medium $3.75, Large $4.25
  - Espresso: Single $2.75, Double $3.50
  - Americano: $3.75
  - Cappuccino / Flat White: $4.50
  - Vanilla Oat Latte: $5.50 (made with locally roasted beans and Minor Figures oat milk)
  - Seasonal Spiced Chai Latte: $5.25
- Milk Alternatives:
  - Oat milk, almond milk, and soy milk available for +$0.75.
- Bakery & Food:
  - Classic Butter Croissant: $3.95
  - Chocolate Hazelnut Babka Slice: $4.50
  - Blueberry Lemon Scone: $3.75
  - Avocado & Sourdough Toast (with feta and chili flakes): $8.50
  - Turkey, Pesto & Provolone Panini: $9.75
  - Vegan Breakfast Burrito (tofu scramble, black beans, salsa): $8.95
- Dietary Options:
  - Gluten-free blueberry scones and vegan cookies are baked daily in a separate prep area. However, our kitchen handles wheat flour, so we cannot guarantee a 100% allergen-free environment for severe celiac disease.

Policies & Returns:
- Drink Remake Policy: If your beverage is not made to your satisfaction (e.g. wrong milk, incorrect temperature, or wrong syrup), notify a barista within 15 minutes of ordering and we will gladly remake it free of charge.
- Packaged Goods & Retail Returns: Unopened bags of coffee beans, mugs, and brewing equipment can be returned or exchanged within 14 days of purchase with the original receipt.
- Prepared Food Policy: Due to health regulations, prepared warm foods and open bakery items cannot be returned or refunded once consumed or taken outside the premises unless there is a quality defect verified by staff.
- Payment Methods: We accept all major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cash. Tips can be added digitally or into the tip jar.
- Catering & Reservations: We do not take table reservations for regular dining. Catering orders (coffee boxes of 10-12 cups, pastry platters) require at least 24 hours advance notice via phone or our website.
